sloka: अथ राजा विदेहानाम् ददौ कन्या धनम् बहु ।गवाम् शत सहस्राणि बहूनि मिथिलेश्वरः ॥१-७४-३॥
transliteration: atha rājā videhānām dadau kanyā dhanam bahu ।gavām śata sahasrāṇi bahūni mithileśvaraḥ ॥1-74-3॥

translations.english: King Janaka, lord of the Videhas, gave plenty of gifts to his daughters and followed king Dasaratha for some distance on his journey to Ayodhya.
